info.name: YP Board
info.description:
End-to-end tests for every server endpoint of YP Board (https://ieee-yp-opportunities.vercel.app).

**How it works.** Apart from `GET /admin/import/template`, the app's endpoints are Next.js Server Actions. Each Server Action is a POST to the page URL. The action ID inside each request changes on every deploy, so the requests don't hard-code it. Instead, each step first GETs the page, copies the form's hidden `$ACTION_*` fields, and replays them as `multipart/form-data`. The bulk import action has no form, so its ID is read from the page's JS chunks. It's called with a `Next-Action` header.

**Setup.** Set the `adminPassword` collection variable, using the *Current value* column so the password isn't saved or exported. Then run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. The admin session lasts 15 minutes.

**Data.** The run creates rows titled `postman-test-<runId>` and `postman-bulk-<runId>`, then permanently deletes them. It doesn't touch any other rows. **Empty trash** is skipped unless `allowDestructive` is `true`, because it hard-deletes *every* trashed row.

exec: // Server Actions reject requests whose Origin doesn't match the host (CSRF check).

item.name: 1. Public & access control
item.description: No session needed. These requests send no cookies.

exec: const form = $('form').filter((i, f) => { const el = $(f); return el.find('input[name="password"]').length > 0; }).first();
pm.test('target form found on page', () => pm.expect(form.length).to.eql(1));
const fields = form.find('input[type="hidden"]').map((i, el) => ({ key: $(el).attr('name'), value: $(el).attr('value') || '' })).get();
pm.test('form carries a Server Action reference', () => pm.expect(fields.some((f) => f.key.startsWith('$ACTION_'))).to.be.true);
pm.request.body.update({ mode: 'formdata', formdata: all.map((f) => ({ key: f.key, value: String(f.value), type: 'text' })) });
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('adminPassword')) throw new Error('Set the adminPassword collection variable first.');
pm.request.body.update({ mode: 'formdata', formdata: all.map((f) => ({ key: f.key, value: String(f.value), type: 'text' })) });

item.name: 5. Bulk import
item.description: `bulkCreateOpportunities` is called from client JS, not a form, so it's a fetch-style action: `Next-Action` header plus a JSON-encoded argument list. The test row is cleaned up afterwards.

body.raw:

  [
    {
      "sheet": "Internships",
      "title": "postman-bulk-{{runId}}",
      "category": "Postman test",
      "level": "Graduate",
      "who": "Automated API test row — safe to delete.",
      "award": "$0",
      "deadline": "Never",
      "status": "Open",
      "membership": "No",
      "notes": "",
      "link": "https://example.com"
    }
  ]
]

item.name: 6. ⚠️ Empty trash (destructive)
item.description: Hard-deletes **every** row in the trash, including real ones. Skipped unless `allowDestructive` is `true`.

exec: console.log('Skipped: set collection variable allowDestructive=true to run this request.');
const form = $('form').filter((i, f) => { const el = $(f); return el.text().includes('Empty trash'); }).first();
pm.test('target form found on page', () => pm.expect(form.length).to.eql(1));
const fields = form.find('input[type="hidden"]').map((i, el) => ({ key: $(el).attr('name'), value: $(el).attr('value') || '' })).get();
pm.test('form carries a Server Action reference', () => pm.expect(fields.some((f) => f.key.startsWith('$ACTION_'))).to.be.true);
console.log('Skipped: set collection variable allowDestructive=true to run this request.');
pm.request.body.update({ mode: 'formdata', formdata: all.map((f) => ({ key: f.key, value: String(f.value), type: 'text' })) });
